summary: Frontend-only testing of SinaisTab configurable strategy system. All 9 requested test cases passed: admin login, EM CONSTRUÇÃO tab entry with password 13052017, gear icon visibility (admin only), config modal open/save with strategy '8/3', non-trigger numbers not firing signal, trigger 11 firing ENTRADA CONFIRMADA with 9 golden entry circles and '2 tentativas restantes', GREEN increment on hit (8 in entry list), RED increment after 2 consecutive misses (20 trigger → 1 miss → 4 miss), strategy name '8/3' shown in card title, and scoreboard using GREEN/RED labels (not WIN/LOSS).
